spec2def(sendmail.dll sendmail.spec)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

file(GLOB_RECURSE sendmail_rc_deps res/*.*)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# sendmail.dll is all Rust (sendmail-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sendmail-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# CDeskLinkDropHandler.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sendmail-rust/src/sendmail/CDeskLinkDropHandler_cpp_h.rs)
# sendmail.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sendmail-rust/src/sendmail/sendmail_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(sendmail_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sendmail_shims PRIVATE uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libadvapi32 libshell32 libuser32 libcomctl32 libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(sendmail_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(sendmail sendmail-cargo sendmail.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE sendmail-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sendmail_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
